_note: Demo coverage only, not a clinical reference. 'drug' is a generic or a class from drug_classes.json. 'with_drug' matches the patient's recorded prescriptions; 'with_condition' matches words in their diagnoses.

rules.message: Non-selective beta-blockers can trigger bronchospasm in asthma.
Non-selective beta-blockers can worsen airway obstruction in COPD.
NSAIDs with an anticoagulant raise the risk of serious bleeding.
NSAIDs can worsen kidney function in chronic kidney disease.
NSAIDs raise the risk of GI bleeding with a peptic ulcer history.
Some people with asthma are sensitive to NSAIDs (aspirin-exacerbated respiratory disease).
Clarithromycin can raise INR in patients on warfarin/acenocoumarol; monitor INR.
Erythromycin can raise INR in patients on warfarin/acenocoumarol; monitor INR.
Fluoroquinolones can raise INR in patients on warfarin/acenocoumarol; monitor INR.
Metformin dosing depends on kidney function; check eGFR.
